type_note: user-visible: music, volume and leaving a voice channel were completely broken.
summary: Music, volume and leaving a voice channel work again, and Nora can be called into voice after a restart.
details: Every music command — play, stop, pause, resume, volume — and `/discord exit` were refused by the audio controller and did nothing. Nora could still join a voice channel and speak, so the failure looked like 'music is broken' rather than a shared cause. Speaking was the only control verb that carried the server id the controller had just started requiring.

Worse, leaving reported success while doing nothing: Nora forgot the connection and told the user she had left, while the bot stayed in the channel until the empty-channel timer eventually removed it.

Separately, an audio controller holding no connections refused EVERY request, including the join that would have created its first one. That is the state after any restart where nobody was in voice — so voice could not be started again for the life of the process, while the container still reported healthy.

A server id in a request is now checked for shape before it is used to name a file or open a connection, and a request naming a server with no live connection says so distinctly instead of reporting a misconfiguration.
limitations: The state directory keeps one file per server. A file left by the previous single-server layout is ignored at startup with a log line rather than being adopted as a server named after the file — which is what happened, on the deploy that introduced it.
The audio link between the two voice containers refuses to start a connection that cannot name its server, instead of quietly forwarding audio the far side discards.
Both halves of that link now skip a zero-length frame rather than one inventing an empty speaker and the other tearing the connection down.
reason: Found by an adversarial review and an architecture audit of the same day's multi-guild work, then reproduced against the live deployment. The control-plane break was pinned as intended behaviour by a test on one side of the seam while the fake on the other side still allowed the old shape, so both suites passed while production was refusing every music verb.
